description: p1 (max_attempts: 2): a 503 with error.type overloaded_error, retried, then a 503 with a flat error body -- the final pass's last attempt has no code, so meta.http_status is 503 with no meta.error_code, and retries_used is 1. p2 (max_attempts: 3): a non-retryable 400 sends exactly one request.
